meta.status: Describes the live look of the AugMind website as of 26 Nov 2026: ink blue and teal.
meta.evidence: Evidence IDs refer to a register kept in the main AugMind repository; it is not part of this copy.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. One of the two page backgrounds; cards and the header also sit on it.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Second page ground, for alternate sections, the drawers and quiet fills such as FAQ plus-buttons.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Pale green fill. In the code for one healthcare section; the two-backgrounds rule says paper and slate only, so do not add new mint sections (open item).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Dark band ground, "ink blue": hero, AI search and healthcare bands, footer, end-of-page call box. Hue 250, darker and about 42% less colourful than the earlier navy #12304A. White text reads 17.8:1. The token keeps the name navy.

tokens.name: navy-2
tokens.usage: One step lighter than the ground, for panels on it. Defined in the code; not used by any component yet.

tokens.name: teal-bright
tokens.usage: The accent on the dark ground: last line of the hero headline, pill, kickers, the large statistic, and the fill of the main button on dark (label in ink, 10.6:1). Same hue as the logo green and the button on light (175). 10.1:1 on the ground. Never on paper or slate.

tokens.name: teal-bright-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the teal button on dark.

tokens.name: navy-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline on navy grounds (footer divider, credit divider). A divider only, never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and strong text on paper and slate. Also the skip link ground (white text 18.6:1).

tokens.name: ink2
tokens.usage: Body-weight secondary text and menu links on paper and slate. 8.3:1 on paper; 7.46:1 measured on the sticky header over navy.

tokens.name: ink3
tokens.usage: Small secondary text on paper, slate and mint. 7:1 or better on all three.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on paper and slate. A divider only, never text.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger border for inputs and outlined chips on paper.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: current-page marker, ticks, small marks on paper. Not for body text; use accent-ink for text.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent text on paper, slate and accent-soft: kickers, text links, the confirmed-sales number. Stays 5.5:1 when dimmed to 84% before the ledger animates.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Pale green fill for positive tags and the fix note. Text on it is accent-ink.

tokens.name: cta-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button ground on light grounds. White text reads 7.5:1.

tokens.name: cta-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover ground.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue for the focus ring, chart line and the blue end of the text gradient. Not body text.

tokens.name: no
tokens.usage: Negative status text on paper and on pale red panels ("No sale found", "Out"). 7:1 or better. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: no-dark
tokens.usage: Negative status text on navy grounds.

tokens.name: ok-dark
tokens.usage: Positive status text on the dark ground. 12.4:1. Lighter than the accent teal so the two differ by lightness.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light grounds: 2px solid, never removed. On navy the ring is white.

tokens.name: grad-a
tokens.usage: Start of the one text gradient (step numbers on paper). 5.29:1 at its weakest point; large display text only.

tokens.name: grad-b
tokens.usage: End of the text gradient. Large display text only.

tokens.name: chart-a
tokens.usage: Chart line and fill. 3:1 or better on paper.

tokens.name: chart-b
tokens.usage: Second chart series. Pair with a label or pattern, never colour alone.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card ground on any band. Cards stay white inside navy bands.

tokens.name: fade-top
tokens.usage: Top of the chart area fill.

tokens.name: fade-none
tokens.usage: Bottom of the chart area fill (fully clear).

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Know what your ad spend really earns.
styles.usage: Page headline, one per page. 64.8px at 1440px wide, about 41px on a phone. The last line may take the text gradient. At weight 800 it is heavier than the headline on every comparison site measured.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Your ad platforms grade their own homework.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and step titles. 20px is the base. The pages also set h3 at 16px (sort card, in Inter 600), 21px (partner names), 24px (step titles) and 28px (booking card): five sizes in all, which is an open item.

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: The three step numbers, in the text gradient.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: We match every lead Google and Meta claim against your actual sales records.
styles.usage: One paragraph under a headline, 60 characters wide at most.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Dashboards count clicks and form fills as wins. Your sales records count paying customers.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Short label above a section headline. Sentence case, never all capitals.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and text-link labels. 15px in the header button.

styles.name: menu
styles.usage: Header links. 17px inside the open phone menu.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Trust line, footer notes, captions. Smallest running text on the site.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Status tags only, always beside an icon.

tokens.name: sec
tokens.usage: Space above and below every section. 96px from 721px wide.

tokens.name: pad
tokens.usage: Side gutter: max(20px, 5vw). Content is at most 1200px wide between the gutters.

tokens.name: gap-head
tokens.usage: Between a section heading block and its content (.sec-head margin).

tokens.name: gap-card
tokens.usage: Padding inside small cards and the agreement panel.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Smallest height for any link or button a finger taps. WCAG floor is 24px; the site holds 44px.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Small chips inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Skip link, menu button, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-14
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles and list rows inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-18
tokens.usage: Cards: ledger, answer card, agreement panel, call box. The main card radius.

tokens.name: radius-20
tokens.usage: Large stat panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills and tags.

radius.note: Names were given here; the code uses the bare values. Also in the code without a token: 50% for circles, 2px, 4px, 8px and 16px on small parts.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Cards that float on light grounds: ledger, sort card, answer card, booking card, sample memo, chart cards.

tokens.name: lift-on-dark
tokens.usage: The same cards when they sit on the dark ground: a deeper, wider shadow. Not a CSS variable in the code; written out in three places.
